2.1.4. om_integration.api.IntegrationConfig¶

class om_integration.api.IntegrationConfig(programs, om_packages, namespace_sep=None)¶

Configuration object for integration with the PiSPEC object model.

Parameters:

  • programs – Programs containing the variables to integrate to.

  • om_packages – Name of the packages defining the object model.

  • namespace_sep – Character used to separate program name from variable name, or PiSPEC class from variable name in configuration files.

Methods

__init__(programs, om_packages[, namespace_sep])

Initialize self.

integrate_safety_program()

Perform integration of CodeAPI.SafetyProgram according to the configuration.

integrate_test_program()

Perform integration of CodeAPI.TestProgram according to the configuration.

integrate_visualization_program()

Perform integration of CodeAPI.VisualizationProgram according to the configuration.

set_project_specific_integration(path)

Configure project specific integration rules for individual instances.

store_config()

Store the configuration for later retrieval with get_stored_generic_intg_rules and get_stored_proj_intg_rules.

use_alias_configuration(alias_cfg[, …])

Setup integration rules by reusing alias configuration.
